objective: Close the three remaining CW-11 dispatch and exit-event races found by the second fresh review.
required_corrections: Make the final dispatch guard end with a fresh authority read after the last potentially blocking callback, including active_run. No callback that can change/read external state may occur between that final authority validation and dispatch except the dispatch itself; fail closed on malformed or changed state.

Do not bind exit events to an immutable run identity using run_id alone. Require or validate the full task/spec/revision/run/session/generation identity and reject/return indeterminate for unbound or stale late events. Preserve compatibility only if it remains fail-closed.

Make on_exit delivery retry-safe and once-only: do not permanently mark surfaced before callback success; prevent concurrent duplicate delivery; after callback exception allow a later retry while preserving no duplicate after success.

Add focused tests for authority mutation inside the final active_run callback, a late old-session exit against a newer same-run-id identity, callback exception then retry, and concurrent/reentrant once-only behavior.
verification: Run observation tests and relevant workflow/bridge/contracts/G4 regressions with /tmp/cw02-g1-venv/bin/python.
Do not rerun the 60-second live probe unless the changed behavior can affect it; state the rationale.
constraints: Use apply_patch only. No uv, local environment, packaging artifacts, workflow-record edits, commit/push/merge/stash/reset/clean, or graphify restore.
